summary: A flat plate with a hairline edge that groups related content: a release, a component summary, a settings section. It does not cast a shadow unless the whole card is one link.

children: Adds a subtle Badge appearance and tightens focus styles.

whenToUse: A self-contained unit the user scans or compares: a release, a component, a token group, an owner.
interactive when the whole card goes to one place (a component page): mark its title link with data-card-primary.
padding none for a full-bleed Table or media inside the card; compact in dense dashboards.
whenNotToUse: As the page structure: rows of identical cards are a lazy layout. Use headings, lists and tables first.
Inside another card: nested plates blur hierarchy. Use a Divider or a heading.
Floating content (menus, popovers): those are overlays with elevation, not cards.

dos.title: One primary action in the footer
dos.text: The footer is for the decision; secondary actions step down to ghost.

children: Design: Florian G. Tech: platform team.

donts.title: A card around a single sentence
donts.text: A box with one line adds noise. Let the text sit on the page.

accessibility: A card is a plain div. Pass aria-labelledby pointing at its title when it should be a navigable group.
Interactive cards keep a real link (data-card-primary) whose text names the destination; its click area is stretched over the card and its focus ring moves to the card edge.
Other buttons inside an interactive card stay on top and remain separately focusable.
The hover lift is skipped when the user prefers reduced motion.
contentGuidelines: Titles are short nouns in sentence case: "Release 1.4.0", "Color tokens".
Body text in one or two sentences; numbers as digits.
